title: The Single Strike
description: 🎯 A single zero in the dead center wipes out its entire row and column.

title: The Double Blast
description: 💥💥 Two zeroes in the top corners overlap their blast radii to decimate the top row and outer columns.

title: The Peaceful Grid
description: 🕊️ No zeroes exist in the matrix whatsoever, so absolutely nothing changes.

title: Total Annihilation
description: 🌪️ Every single cell is already a zero, so the grid remains completely obliterated.

title: The Corner Sneak Attack
description: 🥷 A single zero hiding in the bottom-right corner wipes out the bottom row and rightmost column.

title: The Narrow Hallway
description: 📏 Tests a 1D matrix (a single row) where a single zero collapses the entire structure.

title: The Elevator Shaft
description: 🏢 Tests a 1D vertical matrix (a single column) where one zero drops the whole line to zero.
